DISCHARGE INSTRUCTIONS & CLINICAL SUMMARY

Patient: Vikram Reddy
MRN: MRN-3920184
DOB: 1982-09-30

1. CHIEF COMPLAINT & HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS
Patient presented to the emergency department with worsening symptoms consistent with Osteoarthritis of Knee. Upon admission, initial vitals were stabilized. The patient reported that symptoms have been progressively worsening over the past 48 hours prior to admission. No history of recent trauma.

2. ADMISSION DIAGNOSIS
Osteoarthritis of Knee (ICD-10: M17.9)

3. HOSPITAL COURSE
Admitted for severe knee exacerbation. X-rays confirmed moderate to severe OA. Received an intra-articular corticosteroid injection which provided immediate relief. Discharged with outpatient PT referrals.

4. PERTINENT LABS & IMAGING
During the course of the admission, the following diagnostic procedures were ordered and evaluated: IV Therapy, X-Ray Knee, 3 Views. Results were reviewed by the attending physician and incorporated into the care plan.

5. DISCHARGE MEDICATIONS
• Meloxicam 15mg PO Daily
• Triamcinolone Acetonide Intra-articular Injection
• Ibuprofen 800mg PO TID PRN

6. DISCHARGE INSTRUCTIONS & FOLLOW-UP
DIET: Regular diet as tolerated. Maintain adequate oral hydration. ACTIVITY: Activity as tolerated; avoid strenuous exercise for 1 week. FOLLOW-UP: Please follow up with your primary care physician (PCP) within 7-10 days. Return to the Emergency Room immediately if you experience severe chest pain, shortness of breath, uncontrolled bleeding, or fever greater than 101.5°F.

7. ALLERGIES & CODE STATUS
Allergies: No Known Drug Allergies (NKDA). Code Status: Full Code.
